card.band: 4 h. Each edit format is a separate bucket and partial acceptance with commits and undo is where agents slip. Frontier agents get some formats right but rarely all. A weaker model covers editblock only.
card.cheat: Auto-accepting everything fails the reject and partial cases. Tests compare exact final state, so patching only one format scores only that bucket.
card.grading: Hidden tests drive Coder with scripted model replies (many edit formats and multi-file, multi-hunk cases) and scripted confirmation input. They compare final file trees, chat history and git state with expected values. The existing suite is a regression gate. Score is the fraction of hidden cases passed.
card.reference: Our implementation, expected about 800-1200 added lines plus tests. It defines the expected file, git and history outcomes.
card.task: /app ships a history-less snapshot of aider. Agent implements an option that makes the model's proposed edits reviewable one at a time before they are applied. It covers editblock, wholefile, udiff, patch and architect flows. Per-hunk accept, reject, edit and skip-rest, a non-interactive policy flag, a session auto-accept choice, correct git commit and undo semantics for partial acceptance, and a rejection note fed back to the model.
card.title: Per-change confirmation mode across aider edit formats

facts.claim: Aider issue #649 exists, titled 'Add option to force the AI to ask the user to confirm each change before doing it', and is open (closed and reopened 2024-06-13), opened 2024-06-06
Aider repository licence is Apache License 2.0
No merged or open PR in the first 25 aider PRs returned for confirm/hunk/per-change/per-edit queries implements per-change or per-hunk confirmation; issue #649 shows 'No branches or pull requests'
Aider's current release notes or docs describe a per-hunk or per-edit accept/reject option
Reference implementation (800-1200 lines plus tests) exists

full_card.band: Tier 8 h, not 4 h as seeded: about 7 h of frontier work across five formats plus git semantics. Buckets: each edit format, each accept/reject/edit/skip action, partial-commit git state, undo, flags, rejection note.
full_card.build_cost: About 3 days: 800-1200 line reference, scripted-reply harness, and exact-state fixtures for five formats. smoke_build is empty, so offline build of aider is unverified.
full_card.deliverable: Per-hunk review option across editblock, wholefile, udiff, patch and architect: accept, reject, edit, skip-rest; non-interactive policy flag; session auto-accept; rejection note fed back to the model; git commit and undo semantics for partial acceptance.
full_card.gates_anticheat: Hidden cases and reference outside /app; test and config edits discarded; grading on final trees, git log and chat history. Exact prompt strings, commit message format and history schema must be pinned in the spec, or a valid alternative fails.
full_card.grading_surface: Hidden scripted-reply Coder cases comparing final file trees, chat history and git state; case count not stated in the seed. Existing suite is the regression gate.
full_card.local_fit: Python CLI on CPU, runs offline with scripted model replies; fits the sandbox.
full_card.lookup: none: no PR, release or fork in the checked aider PRs implements per-change confirmation; issue has no linked PRs.
full_card.provenance: Aider GitHub issue #649 (open, opened 2024-06-06; feature request, no linked PR) at commit 5dc9490 / v0.86.0, Apache-2.0, Python, 87 test files.
full_card.reference: Our own implementation, not yet written; expected 800-1200 added lines plus tests.
full_card.ships: History-less aider snapshot at the base commit with no per-change confirmation code; hidden harness and reference kept out of /app.
full_card.similarity: Public-task neighbours max 0.126 (git-to-zig, git-graph), below 0.15. Seed neighbour S-im-109 at 0.349 is not checked for content; K1 not raised.

Band.why: Scope is 8 h work, not 4 h. No dated public evidence, so capped at 3 (E0).

Build.why: About 3 days for the reference, harness and exact-state fixtures.

Fit.why: Python CLI with mocked model replies needs no GPU, network or special kernel features.

Hor.why: Five formats, git partial-commit and undo semantics, and flags make a sustained multi-hour task.

Lic.why: Apache-2.0 confirmed by the LICENSE text.

Multi.why: Each edit format and action is an independent bucket with steady partial credit.

Nov.why: Public neighbours are below 0.15, but S-im-109 at 0.349 is another seed and was not checked for overlap.

Real.why: Real Apache-2.0 repo at a pinned commit and a real open feature request; the 41-upvote claim is wrong (max 28 on one comment).

Ref.why: No reference exists; the spec is loose on prompts, commit messages and history, so exact-state grading is ambiguous.

Seal.why: Reference and hidden harness are ours; no upstream implementation exists to copy.

Surf.why: Scripted cases can be numerous, but the count is unstated and the oracle is our own, so breadth is unproven.

spike_plan.kill_if: Scripted Coder runs cannot be made deterministic, or the existing suite cannot run offline, or partial acceptance cannot be expressed without rewriting the core loop.
spike_plan.pass_if: Editblock scripted run is deterministic across two runs, and partial acceptance produces a predictable tree, commit and chat history that the spec can pin.
steps: Clone aider at 5dc9490 into a scratch container with network; create a venv and pip install -e . ; run the existing test suite once to see whether it is deterministic and offline-clean.
Read aider/coders/ for editblock, wholefile, udiff, patch and architect: find where each applies edits and where io.confirm_ask is called; note the hook point for per-hunk review.
Prototype per-hunk accept/reject/skip for editblock only, driven by a scripted InputOutput that returns a fixed sequence of answers.
Run one scripted Coder session with a fixed reply on a two-file, three-hunk edit: accept hunk 1, reject hunk 2, skip rest; capture file tree, git log and chat history.
Run the same script twice with GIT_AUTHOR_DATE and GIT_COMMITTER_DATE pinned to confirm the outputs are byte-identical.

v1.summary: Aider issue #649 is real and open, with Apache-2.0 licence and no implementing PR found, so the idea passes the paper-trail and lookup gates, though the 41-upvote claim is wrong (max 28) and the seeded 4 h tier is too short for about 7 h of work, so I set 8 h. The main risk is that exact-state grading (chat history, commit form) encodes unpinned choices, so the spec must pin them or the idea should be killed as K9 or K8 after the spike.
